rationale: Retain module SCM provenance for independently built common and virtual-device modules and the existing Kleaf module tests. Adapt modpost to the LTS getopt options, preserving basic and extended modversions. Do not reintroduce the old per-module retpoline stanza: LTS emits shared module metadata in scripts/module-common.c. The sysfs and modinfo additions disclose build identity, not secrets; there is no loader relaxation or historical KMI preservation.
